card.name: Linking words before drug or mineral names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, of, to, and/or) or the start of a long word, right before a specific drug, mineral or condition name in drug-label text. Often seen near potassium, phosphorus, calcium or Crohn's disease.

modes.label: Linking word before a name
modes.description: A word like and, of or to that comes just before a named drug or body site.

modes.label: Start of a long mineral or drug word
modes.description: The first piece of a long word such as phosphorus or polystyrene, cut off before the rest.
modes.example: Adjust dosage as needed until an acceptable serum<< phosph>>orus level is reached, with regular monitoring

card.writes: Promotes odd word pieces and code-like strings, so it adds little clear meaning to the output.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or word start just before a drug, mineral or condition name is spelled out.
